Core Active Vocabulary (10 items):

shop — a place where you buy things. Example: Every shop has a discount.
look — to direct your eyes at something. Example: I'm just looking, thanks.
help — to make things easier for someone. Example: Can I help you?
size — how big or small clothes are. Example: What size is this?
colour — red, blue, green and so on. Example: Do you have it in another colour?
try on — to put clothes on to see if they fit. Example: Can I try it on?
change — to make something different. Example: Can I change it?
receipt — the paper proving you paid. Example: Keep your receipt.
browse — to look around a shop without buying. Example: I'm just browsing.
assistant — a person who helps customers. Example: The assistant asks if I need help.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• I'm just looking, thanks.
• Can I help you?
• Could you help me with ...?
• What size is this?
• Can I try it on?
